title: Rights decision
description: The rights state attached to one source_registry.json record. Structural shape only -- scripts/equipment_identity/rights.py's eligibility helpers are the actual fail-closed enforcement (a static schema cannot express 'legalReviewState must equal REVIEWED before displayAllowed is trusted', only that the field exists and has the right type).

legalReviewState.description: UNREVIEWED is the default and the only state a source may seed at without captured, reviewed terms evidence. REVIEWED means a human reviewed actual captured terms (termsCaptured=true, ideally with termsSnapshotSha256). BLOCKED means review happened and the answer was no -- distinct from UNREVIEWED, which just means nobody has looked yet.

noAiRestriction.description: true means the source's terms explicitly forbid AI/ML use (a 'No AI' clause or equivalent). This is a HARD block on recognition processing, training and derivative use regardless of any other permission boolean -- see rights.py's eligibility helpers.

termsCaptured.description: true only if the actual terms text has been captured (a snapshot exists), never inferred from a source's reputation or category.

termsSnapshotSha256.description: sha256 of the captured terms snapshot, when one exists. Required in practice (by rights.py, not this schema) whenever termsCaptured=true.

reviewedAt.description: ISO-8601. Required in practice whenever legalReviewState != UNREVIEWED.

recheckAt.description: ISO-8601. When this decision should be re-reviewed (terms can change).

decisionBasis.description: Free-text note on why the decision was made. Never itself a source of permission -- a string like 'royalty free' here grants nothing; the boolean fields are the only thing rights.py reads for eligibility.
